prompt:
Derived asset, not generated. Origin: public/avatar.jpg (the owner's own photograph, already in this repo).
Processed with ImageMagick for The Throw's single-light rule, so the portrait carries the lamp's colour and nothing else, and so the arcade behind him falls back instead of competing with the name:
1. magick -size 2160x2880 radial-gradient:'#FFFFFF-#4A4A4A' -crop 1080x1440+680+1160 +repage falloff.png
   (a radial falloff cropped so its centre lands on his face at roughly 400,280 rather than on the frame centre)
2. magick public/avatar.jpg -crop 700x933+210+55 +repage -resize 1080x1440 -colorspace Gray -level 4%,95%,1.0 \( -size 1x512 gradient:'#13100B-#FFEFD6' \) -clut -channel R -gamma 1.14 -channel B -gamma 0.86 +channel -brightness-contrast -7x14 -quality 88 public/portrait-lit.jpg
3. magick public/portrait-lit.jpg falloff.png -compose multiply -composite \( -size 1080x1440 gradient:'#FFFFFF-#9A9A9A' -rotate 90 -resize 1080x1440! \) -compose multiply -composite -quality 88 public/portrait-lit.jpg
   (the second multiply is the left-to-right falloff: the shadow side drops away toward the frame edge)
The .webp is the same file at -quality 82. Replace both from a new source photo the same way.
